settings.help: Whatever you want the name of the server to be.
settings.label: Server Name

settings.help: Whatever you want the server description to be, will be shown in the server browser.
settings.label: Server Description

settings.help: Website URL for the server, will be shown in the serverbrowser as a clickable link.
settings.label: Server Website URL

settings.help: Password to gain entry to the server.
settings.label: Server Password

settings.help: If set the user will see the message during joining the server and has to confirm it before continuing.
settings.label: Server Login Confirmation Text

settings.help: The region this server is in.
settings.label: Region

settings.help: Primary language for players on this server. Should be the English name of the language, e.g. not "Deutsch" but "German"
settings.label: Language

settings.help: As you are never a friend of a dedicated server, setting this to "Only shown to friends" will only work when the first player connects manually by IP.
settings.label: Server Visibility

settings.help: Dedicated servers should disable SteamNetworking if there is no NAT router in between your users and the server or when port-forwarding is set up correctly.
settings.label: Server Disabled Network Protocols

settings.help: Maximum speed in kiB/s the world is transferred at to a client on first connect if it does not have the world yet. Maximum is about 1300 kiB/s, even if you set a higher value.
settings.label: Server Max World Transfer Speed

settings.help: Out of the Server Max Player Count this many slots can only be used by players with a specific permission level.
settings.label: Server Reserved Slots

settings.help: Required permission level to use the reserved slots above.
settings.label: Server Reserved Slots Permission

settings.help: This many admins can still join even if the server has reached Server Max Player Count. Only applies to server versions Alpha 20.7 and above.
settings.label: Server Admin Slots

settings.help: Required permission level to use the admin slots above. Only applies to server versions Alpha 20.7 and above.
settings.label: Server Admin Slots Permission

settings.help: Enable/Disable players joining with the same profile they last logged in with.
settings.label: Persistent Player Profiles

settings.help: Password to gain entry to the control panel. This only applies to game version 20.7 and below.
settings.label: Control Panel Password

settings.help: External URL to the web dashboard if not just using the public IP of the server, e.g. if the web dashboard is behind a reverse proxy. Needs to be the full URL, like "https://domainOfReverseProxy.tld:1234/". Can be left empty if directly using the public IP and dashboard port. Only applies to server versions Alpha 21.0 and above.
settings.label: Web Dashboard URL

settings.help: Enable/disable rendering of the map to tile images while exploring it. This is used e.g. by the web dashboard to display a view of the map.
settings.label: Web Dashboard Map Rendering Enabled

settings.help: After this many wrong passwords from a single remote client the client will be blocked from connecting to the Telnet interface.
settings.label: Telnet Failed Login Limit

settings.help: How long will the block persist.
settings.label: Telnet Failed Logins Block Time

settings.help: Server admin file name. Path relative to User/Saves.
settings.label: Admin File Name

settings.help: Enables/Disables crossplay. Server Max Player Count must be no more than 8, EAC must be enabled, and Ignore EOS Sanctions must be disabled. See crossplay requirements. Only applies to server versions 2.0 and above.
settings.label: Crossplay Enabled

settings.help: Enables/Disables EasyAntiCheat. Selecting an overhaul mod under "Mod Mode" in the Updates section disables EasyAntiCheat automatically and overrides this setting, because overhaul mods load their own code and players would otherwise be kicked when they connect. Note that disabling EasyAntiCheat also prevents console players from joining, so a server cannot run an overhaul mod and support crossplay at the same time.
settings.label: EAC Enabled

settings.help: Hide logging of command execution..
settings.label: Hide Command Execution Log
labels: Also hide from remote game clients

settings.help: Override how many chunks can be uncovered on the ingame map by each player. Resulting max map file size limit per player is (x * 512 Bytes), uncovered area is (x * 256 m²). Default 131072 means max 32 km² can be uncovered at any time.
settings.label: Max Uncovered Map Chunks Per Player

settings.help: The number of in-game days which must pass since visiting a chunk before it will reset to its original state if not revisited or protected (e.g. by a land claim or bedroll being in close proximity).
settings.label: Max Chunk Age

settings.help: The maximum disk space allowance for each saved game in megabytes (MB). Saved chunks may be forceably reset to their original states to free up space when this limit is reached. Negative values disable the limit.
settings.label: Save Data Limit

settings.help: Ignore EOS sanctions when allowing players to join. Only applies to server versions 1.0 and above.
settings.label: Ignore EOS Sanctions

settings.help: "RWG" (see WorldGenSeed and WorldGenSize options below) or any already existing world name in the 'Data/Worlds' or 'User/GeneratedWorlds' folders.
settings.label: Game World

settings.help: If RWG this is the seed for the generation of the new world. If a world with the resulting name already exists it will simply load it.
settings.label: World Gen Seed

settings.help: If RWG, this controls the width and height of the created world. Officially supported sizes are between 6144 and 10240 and must be a multiple of 2048, e.g. 6144, 8192, 10240.
settings.label: World Gen Size

settings.help: Whatever you want the game name to be (letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, dashes and periods only). This affects the save game name as well as the seed used when placing decoration (trees etc) in the world. It does not control the generic layout of the world if creating an RWG world.
settings.label: Game Name

settings.help: Only one game mode available at this time. Placeholder for future options.
settings.label: Game Mode

settings.help: Sets the Sandbox Code for configuring various sandbox gameplay options. Default = Adventurer difficulty. Generate a code by using this unofficial online generator, or by clicking the sandbox options button on the new game screen in-game and adjusting the options. Only applies to server versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Sandbox Code

settings.help: Sets the difficulty level of the game. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Game Difficulty

settings.help: How much damage do players to blocks (percentage in whole numbers). Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Player Block Damage

settings.help: How much damage do AIs do to blocks (percentage in whole numbers). Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: AI Block Damage

settings.help: How much damage do AIs do during blood moons to blocks (percentage in whole numbers). Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: AI Block Damage Blood Moon

settings.help: XP gain multiplier (percentage in whole numbers). Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: XP Multiplier

settings.help: If a player is less or equal this level he will create a safe zone (no enemies).
settings.label: Player Safe Zone Level

settings.help: Hours in world time this safe zone exists.
settings.label: Player Safe Zone Hours

settings.help: cheat mode on/off.
settings.label: Build Create

settings.help: Real time minutes per in game day: 60 minutes. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Day Night Length

settings.help: In game hours the sun shines per day: 18 hours day light per in game day. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Day Light Length

settings.help: Enable/disable biome hazards. Weather and storms are not affected by this setting. Only applies to server versions 2.0 to below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Biome Progression

settings.help: Adjusts the frequency of storms. 0 turns them off. Vanilla values: 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400, 500. Only applies to server versions 2.0 to below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Storm Frequency

settings.help: Penalty after dying. This setting has different meeanings between the base game and Undead Legacy modded servers. Base game - Nothing: no penalty. Default: classic XP penalty. Injured: you keep most of your debuffs, food and water are set to 50% on respawn. Permanent Death: your character is completely reset and respawns fresh within the saved game. Undead Legacy - Nothing: no XP debt and no attribute-lowering debuff. Beginner: near death trauma debuff, closest to the base game experience. Moderate: as Beginner, plus loss of random action skills. Standard: as Moderate, plus you respawn with partial health, food and water.
settings.label: Death Penalty
labels: Default: Classic XP Penalty / UL Beginner

settings.help: What a player drops upon death. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Drop On Death

settings.help: What a player drops when quitting. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Drop On Quit

settings.help: Size (box "radius", so a box with 2 times the given value for each side's length) of bedroll deadzone, no zombies will spawn inside this area, and any cleared sleeper volumes that touch a bedroll deadzone will not spawn after they've been cleared.
settings.label: Bedroll Dead Zone Size

settings.help: Number of real world days a bedroll stays active after owner was last online.
settings.label: Bedroll Expiry Time

settings.help: Whether new players joining the server for the first time can select to join near any friend playing at the same time. Only applies to server versions 2.0 and above.
settings.label: Allow Spawn Near Friend
labels: Only near friends in forest biome (default)

settings.help: Allow players to respawn near their last dropped backpack when they die. Only applies to server versions Alpha 21.0 to Alpha 21.1.
settings.label: Allow Spawn Near Backpack

settings.help: Sets whether and how camera views are restricted for players. Only applies to server versions 2.5 and above.
settings.label: Camera Restriction Mode
labels: Can freely swap between first and third person views

settings.help: The empty jar refund percentage after consuming an item. Only applies to server versions 2.5 to below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Jar Refund Percentage

settings.help: This count covers the entire world. It is scaled based on use case (x1.9 blood moons, x2.1 sleepers). Changing this setting can have a huge impact on performance.
settings.label: Max Spawned Zombies

settings.help: If your server has a large number of players you can increase this limit to add more wildlife. Animals don't consume as much CPU as zombies. NOTE: That this doesn't cause more animals to spawn arbitrarily: The biome spawning system only spawns a certain number of animals in a given area, but if you have lots of players that are all spread out then you may be hitting the limit and can increase it.
settings.label: Max Spawned Animals

settings.help: Max viewdistance a client may request (6 - 12). High impact on memory usage and performance.
settings.label: Server Max Allowed View Distance

settings.help: Maximum amount of Chunk mesh layers that can be enqueued during mesh generation. Reducing this will improve memory usage but may increase Chunk generation time.
settings.label: Max Queued Mesh Layers

settings.help: Enable/Disable enemy spawning. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Enemy Spawn Mode

settings.help: Difficulty of the enemies. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Enemy Difficulty

settings.help: When zombies should have feral sense. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Zombie Feral Sense

settings.help: Zombie movement speed during the day. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Zombie Move Day

settings.help: Zombie movement speed during the night. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Zombie Move Night

settings.help: Zombie movement speed of feral zombies. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Zombie Feral Move

settings.help: Zombie movement speed during a blood moon. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Zombie Move Blood Moon

settings.help: Zombie movement speed after detecting a smell. Only applies to server versions 2.5 to below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Zombie Smell Movement Speed

settings.help: What frequency (in days) should a blood moon take place. Set to "0" for no blood moons. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Blood Moon Frequency

settings.help: How many days can the actual blood moon day randomly deviate from the above setting. Setting this to 0 makes blood moons happen exactly each Nth day as specified in Blood Moon Frequency. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Blood Moon Range

settings.help: The Hour number that the red day number begins on a blood moon day. Setting this to -1 makes the red never show. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Blood Moon Warning

settings.help: This is the number of zombies that can be alive (spawned at the same time) at any time PER PLAYER during a blood moon horde, however, MaxSpawnedZombies overrides this number in multiplayer games. Also note that your game stage sets the max number of zombies PER PARTY. Low game stage values can result in lower number of zombies than the BloodMoonEnemyCount setting. Changing this setting has a huge impact on performance. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Blood Moon Enemy Count

settings.help: Percentage of loot in whole numbers. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Loot Abundance

settings.help: Days in whole numbers for loot to respawn. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Loot Respawn Days

settings.help: How often airdrop occur in game-hours, 0 = never. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Air Drop Frequency

settings.help: Sets if a marker is added to map/compass for air drops. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Air Drop Marker

settings.help: The distance you must be within to receive party shared kill xp and quest party kill objective credit.
settings.label: Party Shared Kill Range

settings.help: Player Killing Settings.
settings.label: Player Killing Mode

settings.help: Maximum allowed land claims per player.
settings.label: Land Claim Count

settings.help: Size in blocks that is protected by a keystone.
settings.label: Land Claim Size

settings.help: Keystones must be this many blocks apart (unless you are friends with the other player).
settings.label: Land Claim Dead Zone

settings.help: The number of real world days a player can be offline before their claims expire and are no longer protected.
settings.label: Land Claim Expiry Time

settings.help: Controls how offline players land claims decay.
settings.label: Land Claim Decay Mode
labels: None (Full protection until claim is expired)

settings.help: How much protected claim area block hardness is increased when a player is online. 0 means infinite (no damage will ever be taken). Default is 4x.
settings.label: Land Claim Online Durability Modifier

settings.help: How much protected claim area block hardness is increased when a player is offline. 0 means infinite (no damage will ever be taken). Default is 4x.
settings.label: Land Claim Offline Durability Modifier

settings.help: The number of minutes after a player logs out that the land claim area hardness transitions from online to offline. Default is 0.
settings.label: Land Claim Offline Delay

settings.help: Is Dynamic Mesh system enabled?
settings.label: Dynamic Mesh Enabled

settings.help: Is Dynamic Mesh system only active in player LCB areas?
settings.label: Dynamic Mesh Land Claim Only

settings.help: Dynamic Mesh LCB chunk radius.
settings.label: Dynamic Mesh Land Claim Buffer

settings.help: How many items can be processed concurrently, higher values use more RAM.
settings.label: Dynamic Mesh Max Item Cache

settings.help: Required permission level to use twitch integration on the server.
settings.label: Twitch Server Permission Level

settings.help: If the server allows twitch actions during a blood moon. This could cause server lag with extra zombies being spawned during blood moon.
settings.label: Twitch Blood Moon Allowed

settings.help: Limits the number of quests that contribute to quest tier progression a player can complete each day. Quests after the limit can still be completed for rewards. -1 = infinite. Only applies to server versions 1.0 to below 3.0 - use the Sandbox Code for versions 3.0 and above.
settings.label: Quest Progression Daily Limit

settings.help: Sets the server release stream to install. The "Public" branch has the latest stable version of the server. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Release Stream must also be specified. Update the server after changing this setting.
settings.label: Release Stream

settings.help: Sets a custom release stream to use for the Release Stream, if "Custom" is selected. Useful for any release streams not yet included in the Release Stream list
settings.label: Custom Release Stream

settings.help: Sets whether to install and run the standard server, or a relevant overhaul mod. You must also set the Release Stream accordingly. EAC is automatically disabled when running an overhaul mod (overriding AMP's setting). Set the Game World to "RWG" or a custom Darkness Falls map when running Darkness Falls. Update the server after changing this setting.
settings.label: Mod Mode

settings.help: Auto-installs uMod when the server is updated.
settings.label: Install uMod

settings.help: Controls how recipes are displayed.
settings.label: Recipe Filter
labels: Shows unknown recipes, search limited by workstation
Shows only known and workstation relevant recipes

settings.help: Determines if you trigger the tutorial challenges upon first spawning on the server. On the Stable (Alpha 20.7) build this is the older "StarterQuestEnabled" option, which AMP sets from this same value.
settings.label: Basic Survival Challenges

settings.help: After how many in-game hours a wandering horde would occur. On top of this value 1 to 4 additional hours may be added depending on spawn conditions. Minimum Value: 1
settings.label: Wandering Horde Frequency

settings.help: Additional random hours added to Wandering Horde Frequency to add randomness to hours between spawns. For example, Frequency: 5, Frequency RNG Range: 10, then wandering horde will spawn anywhere between 5 to 15 (5+10) in-game hours + additional hours if special conditions occur (No players alive, etc).
settings.label: Wandering Horde Frequency Range

settings.help: Fixed zombie count, that will spawn in a Wandering horde. Minimum Value: 2. Zombies + Zombie RNG Range value must not exceed: 64
settings.label: Wandering Horde Count

settings.help: This value determines up to how many additional zombies can spawn for Wandering Horde. For example, Zombies: 5, Zombies RNG Range: 10, then wandering horde will spawn anywhere between 5 to 15 5+10 zombies. Combined value must not exceed: 64
settings.label: Wandering Horde Count Range

settings.help: Multiplier determining how important a POI Tier is when scaling Loot Stage. 0% - Disabled Default, 100% Vanilla Scaling. Acceptable values are integers from 0 to 100
settings.label: POI Tier Loot Scale

settings.help: Undead Legacy's separate stats death penalty (the mod's "DeathPenalty2" option), applied on top of the Death Penalty setting under Gameplay. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Stats Death Penalty
labels: Trauma debuff + lose random Action Skills
Trauma debuff + lose random Action Skills + respawn with partial Health, Food and Water

settings.help: Percentage chance for a zombie to rage. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Zombie Rage Chance

settings.help: Enables screamer/scout zombies spawning from the heat map. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Heat Map Scouts Enabled

settings.help: Controls when zombies are allowed to dig. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Zombie Digging Enabled
labels: Can dig only during blood moons

settings.help: Damage boost applied to grouped zombies. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Group Damage Boost

settings.help: Multiplier applied to Action Skill experience gain. 100% is the mod default. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Action Skill XP Multiplier

settings.help: Cooldown before trader missions become available again. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Trader Mission Cooldown

settings.help: In-game hour at which dusk begins. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Dusk Time

settings.help: In-game hour at which dawn begins. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Dawn Time

settings.help: Ambient light level used by the mod at night. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Ambient Light Level

settings.help: Forces a fixed brightness level on clients. -1 leaves brightness up to each player. Experimental builds only.
settings.label: Override Brightness

settings.help: Sets the name of the server as shown in the Steam server browser
settings.label: Server Name

settings.help: Sets the name of the world save folder to load, or to create if it does not exist
settings.label: World Save Name

settings.help: Sets the password for players to join the server. Default is no password
settings.label: Server Password

settings.help: Sets the password for players to become a whitelisted admin in-game. Default is no password (disabled). Recommended for console users, as manual admin whitelisting is only supported for Steam
settings.label: Admin Password

settings.help: Sets whether to allow crossplay or to limit the server to a specific platform
settings.label: Crossplay Mode

settings.help: If set, the server will be forced to use performance threads on the CPU. Recommended
settings.label: Use CPU Performance Threads

settings.help: If set, the server will be forced to use all available cores. Disable Pause To Load Assets if you use this. Recommended on newer hardware
settings.label: Use All Available Cores

settings.help: If set, the server will be forced to pause to load new assets/level sectors instead of slowly loading them. Recommended on older hardware
settings.label: Pause To Load Assets

settings.help: If set, the server will be run as LAN only, which allows the server to be found in-game using the server browser set to LAN Only. Port 14001 must be accessible for server discovery to work
settings.label: LAN Only

settings.help: If set, allows the server to bind to local IPs as well as the Application IP Binding, assuming the Application IP Binding does not otherwise do this. Use with care, as enabling this setting may cause port conflicts
settings.label: Use Local IPs

settings.help: If set, UObject listeners will be created in GUObjectArray to create a fast cache for use instead of iterating GUObjectArray. Recommended to keep disabled for UE4SS mods to avoid crashes
settings.label: Enable UE4SS UObject Listeners

settings.help: Specifies additional command line arguments (anything that begins with a - ) that are not otherwise set by AMP. Use with care
settings.label: Additional Command Line Arguments

settings.help: When creating a new world save, sets (for all players) how many enemies may be present in some areas, how aggressive they are, and how fast they react in combat. Overridden to Apocalyptic if Hardcore Mode is enabled
settings.label: Difficulty Level

settings.help: If set, characters only have one life and difficulty is forced to Apocalyptic
settings.label: Enable Hardcore Mode

settings.help: If set, resources (other than furniture) will spontaneously respawn around the Facility. Good for public servers, but can cause objects to intersect or float, and will make some resource gathering very unbalanced
settings.label: Enable Loot Respawn

settings.help: If set, power in the Facility will be shut off at night, including power sockets. Disabling this setting will make the game easier as things like Batteries will not be required. Disabling may also be required if the Day-Night Cycle State is set to 'Always night'
settings.label: Shut Off Power Sockets At Night

settings.help: Sets whether to disable the day-night cycle. If 'Always day' or 'Always night', time will pass as normal, but there will be no day-night transition. Change from 'Normal' at your own risk, as that may affect things that can only happen during day or night
settings.label: Day-Night Cycle State

settings.help: Sets the speed multiplier for the day-night cycle. Higher will make clock time pass faster. This will NOT affect the speed of other cooldowns, respawn times, and so on
settings.label: Day-Night Cycle Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets how often weather events are triggered. Even frequent weather still requires the correct progression to trigger, however
settings.label: Weather Frequency

settings.help: Sets how quickly sinks will passively refill over time. Higher will mean sinks refill more quickly, and a lower value will make them refill more slowly. 0 = disable sink refill, making the game much more challenging
settings.label: Sink Refill Rate

settings.help: Sets how fast food spoils. By default, most food will eventually decay and turn into rotten food. Higher will mean faster decay, lower means slower. 0 = decay disabled
settings.label: Food Spoil Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets how effective it is to refrigerate items. Also affects how effective hot items maintain their heat if they prefer staying warm and are kept in a warm location
settings.label: Refrigeration Effectiveness Multiplier

settings.help: Sets how frequently enemies respawn. Lower will increase enemy respawn timers, higher will cause enemies to respawn more quickly than normal. Minimum 0.5
settings.label: Enemy Spawn Rate

settings.help: Sets the multiplier for enemy health. Lower will make enemies easier to kill, higher will mean enemies will take more damage to kill. Minimum 0.75
settings.label: Enemy Health Multiplier

settings.help: Sets how damaging enemies are, as a multiplier of their damage. Default value is tuned for a fair and balanced experience. Lower will make survivability easier, higher will make combat more challenging and enemies more lethal. Minimum 0.25
settings.label: Enemy Player Damage Multiplier

settings.help: Sets how much damage enemies do to deployables, as a multiplier of their damage. Lower will make bases more resistant to enemy attacks. Minimum 0.1
settings.label: Enemy Deployable Damage Multiplier

settings.help: Sets how much damage players do to other players, as a proportion of normal damage. To allow players to engage in PvP combat, set to 1.0 (100%) or higher
settings.label: Damage To Allies Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the multiplier for how fast Hunger increases. Higher will mean players need to eat more often
settings.label: Hunger Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the multiplier for how fast Thirst increases. Higher will mean players need to drink more often
settings.label: Thirst Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the multiplier for how fast Fatigue increases. Higher will mean players get sleepier more quickly
settings.label: Fatigue Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the multiplier for how fast Continence drains. Higher will mean players have to use the toilet more often
settings.label: Continence Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets how fast enemies detect players. Above 1 will mean enemies will detect players faster than normal. Minimum 0.1
settings.label: Detection Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Determines how many additional perk points are available on top of the points given by each selected job
settings.label: Bonus Perk Points

settings.help: Sets the multiplier for how fast XP is gained by players. Above 1 will mean XP is gained at a higher rate, below 1 will mean XP is gained slower. 0 = disable ability to level up skills
settings.label: Player XP Gain Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the multiplier for how many times items can be stacked in an inventory slot. For example, 2 = double stack height. Non-stackable items are excluded
settings.label: Item Stack Size Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the multiplier affecting how heavy items are in a player's inventory. For example, 2 = twice as heavy. For items to be lighter, set this value lower than 1
settings.label: Item Weight Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the multiplier for item durability. For example, 2 = double durability. To break items faster, set this value below 1
settings.label: Item Durability Multiplier

settings.help: Sets how much durability is lost on weapons and items in a player's inventory when respawning
settings.label: Durability Loss On Death Multiplier

settings.help: If sets, players will be notified when someone is killed by something
settings.label: Show Death Messages

settings.help: If set, players will be able to share item recipes with other players
settings.label: Allow Recipe Sharing

settings.help: If set, Pagers will be usable in inventory and via the emote wheel. Disabling this setting will make it harder to find other players
settings.label: Allow Pagers

settings.help: If set, players can transmogrify their armour to look like other pieces of armour using a certain piece of base equipment
settings.label: Allow Transmog

settings.help: If set, the Research Minigames will be removed when unlocking new recipes and simply unlock the recipe right away
settings.label: Disable Research Minigames

settings.help: Sets what penalties a player receives for respawning after death (or by using the Unstick option)
settings.label: Death Penalties

settings.help: Sets the weapon players receive when spawning for the first time, in addition to starting items from their selected Job
settings.label: First Time Starting Weapon

settings.help: If set, the host will be able to access the inventory items found in Death Bags, which are typically dropped by players on death
settings.label: Allow Death Bag Inventory Access

settings.help: If set, containers will be restricted by item type
settings.label: Restrict Containers

settings.help: Sets the limit on how much furniture and other deployables can be stacked. 0 = disabled
settings.label: Structural Support Limit

settings.help: If set, allows players to reset their jobs, skills, and traits later in the game. Disabling removes the ability for scientists to change their mind
settings.label: Allow Character Reset

settings.help: Bridges require two supports by default. When lowered, bridges will work with less or 0 additional support (besides the initial location the bridge is placed)
settings.label: Bridge Supports Level

settings.help: If set, Home Worlds can be used in the world. If disabled, access (for all scientists) to Home World portal worlds will be restricted. This includes free or DLC Home Worlds, such as Torii
settings.label: Allow Home Worlds

settings.help: If set, radiation will not show any screen effect, requiring Geiger Counters to track radiation
settings.label: Enable Invisible Radiation

settings.help: Sets the default inventory size when no backpack is equipped
settings.label: Base Inventory Size

settings.help: If set, sink (or similar) drinkable water sources will instead be tainted water
settings.label: Enable Tainted Sink Water

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of tamed creatures on the server. This is a global cap
settings.label: Maximum Tamed Creatures

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of tamed creatures that a tribe is allowed to have
settings.label: Maximum Personal Tamed Creatures

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of slots for uploaded creatures
settings.label: Maximum Tribute Creatures

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of structures that can be constructed within a certain range
settings.label: Maximum Structures

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of slots for uploaded items and resources
settings.label: Maximum Tribute Items

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of players in each tribe. 0 = no limit, 1 = tribes effectively disabled
settings.label: Maximum Players In Tribe

settings.help: If set, tribes will be prevented from creating alliances
settings.label: Prevent Tribe Alliances

settings.help: If set, prevents friendly fire among tribe-mates, tribe-creatures and tribe-structures on PvP servers
settings.label: Disable PvP Friendly Fire

settings.help: If set, prevents friendly fire among tribe-mates, tribe-creatures and tribe-structures on PvE servers
settings.label: Disable PvE Friendly Fire

settings.help: If set, allows gamma changes in PvP mode
settings.label: Enable PvP Gamma

settings.help: If set, prevents gamma changes in PvE mode
settings.label: Disable PvE Gamma

settings.help: If set, players will always be notified if someone joins the server
settings.label: Notify Player Join

settings.help: If set, players will always be notified if someone leaves the server
settings.label: Notify Player Leave

settings.help: If set, voice chat will be enabled globally
settings.label: Enable Global Voice Chat

settings.help: If set, only players near each other can see each other's chat messages
settings.label: Enable Proximity Chat

settings.help: If set, allows building in caves in PvE mode
settings.label: Allow PvE Cave Building

settings.help: If set, flyers will be permitted to pick up other creatures and players when mounted by a player in PvE mode
settings.label: Allow PvE Flyer Carry

settings.help: If set, flyers can have their movement speed levelled up
settings.label: Allow Flyer Speed Levelling

settings.help: If set, flyers will always be allowed into caves
settings.label: Allow Cave Flyers

settings.help: If set, wild creatures will not be spawned in the server. For an existing server, existing creatures need to be wiped with the admin command "destroywilddinos"
settings.label: Disable Wild Creature Spawn

settings.help: If set, creatures in inactive zones will not hibernate, at the cost of performance and memory usage
settings.label: Prevent Hibernation

settings.help: If set, all wild creatures that are not currently being tamed will be destroyed on server start
settings.label: Force Wild Creature Respawn On Start

settings.help: Sets the period to force respawns of wild creatures to prevent certain types (like the Basilo and Spino) from becoming depopulated on long running servers, as well as removing any lingering event creatures. 0 = disabled
settings.label: Force Wild Creature Respawn At Interval

settings.help: If set, the Tek Railgun will be disabled in PvP mode
settings.label: Disable Tek Railgun

settings.help: If set, loot crates will not spawn. Artifact crates will still spawn
settings.label: Disable Loot Crates

settings.help: Sets the distance around players where resources are not allowed to grow back. Values higher than 1 increase it, values between 0 and 1 reduce it
settings.label: Player Radius For No Resource Replenish

settings.help: Sets the distance around structures where resources are not allowed to grow back. Values higher than 1 increase it, values between 0 and 1 reduce it
settings.label: Structure Radius For No Resource Replenish

settings.help: If set, the gradual (7 days) decay (or unclaiming) of creature ownership will be disabled in PvE mode. Otherwise, every creature can be claimed by any player
settings.label: Disable PvE Creature Decay

settings.help: If set, the gradual decay (or unclaiming) of creature ownership will be enabled in PvP mode
settings.label: Enable PvP Creature Decay

settings.help: If set, wild creatures and riderless creatures can take damage from passive defence structures like spikewalls
settings.label: Enable Passive Defence Damage

settings.help: If set, diseases will be completely disabled on the server
settings.label: Prevent Diseases

settings.help: If set, diseases will not be permanent (they will be lost on respawn)
settings.label: Disable Permanent Diseases

settings.help: If set, enables anyone to "take care" of baby creatures (cuddle etc), not just whomever imprinted on it
settings.label: Allow Care By Anyone

settings.help: If set, disables the creature imprinting player Stat Bonus (where whomever specifically imprinted on the creature, and raised it to have an imprinting quality, gets extra damage/resistance buff)
settings.label: Disable Imprint Creature Buff

settings.help: If set, water pipes will be destroyed automatically after two real-time days, if unconnected to any non-pipe (directly or indirectly) and no allied player is nearby
settings.label: Destroy Unconnected Water Pipes

settings.help: Sets the cooldown period between allowed creature re-uploads
settings.label: Minimum Creature Re-upload Interval

settings.help: If set, claimable decayed creatures will be auto-destroyed on load, rather than remaining around as claimable
settings.label: Auto Destroy Decayed Creatures

settings.help: If set, optimizes the server performance when using a higher Harvest Amount Multiplier, by reducing the bias towards yielding rarer items
settings.label: Optimize Harvest Amount Multiplier

settings.help: If set, allows flyers to fly with C4 attached to them. Otherwise, except for Quetzal and Wyvern, they can't fly
settings.label: Force Flyer Explosives

settings.help: If enabled, more than one C4 can be attached per creature
settings.label: Allow Multiple Attached C4

settings.help: If set, flyers can recover stamina when a player is standing on them instead of riding
settings.label: Allow Flying Stamina Recovery

settings.help: If set, fog is disabled
settings.label: Disable Weather Fog

settings.help: If enabled, supply drops will be in random locations. NOTE: This setting is known to cause artifacts to become inaccessible on the Ragnarok map
settings.label: Enable Random Supply Crate Points

settings.help: If set, enables tribute download of non-native creatures on the Aberration map
settings.label: Allow Foreign Creature Downloads on Aberration

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the server day/night cycle. The default value 1 sets the same speed as a singleplayer game, ie 1 minute real time = approx 28 minutes server time. A scale of 0.035 would set a day/night cycle of approx 24 hours real time
settings.label: Day/Night Cycle Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the length of each server day, relative to the length of each night. Lowering this value increases the day length
settings.label: Day Time Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the length of each server night, relative to the length of each day. Lowering this value increases the night length
settings.label: Night Time Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for experience (XP) received by players, tribes and creatures for various actions. The default value 1 provides the same experience as a singleplayer game. Higher values increase XP amounts awarded, lower values decrease it
settings.label: XP Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for player characters' food consumption. Higher values increase food consumption (player characters get hungry faster)
settings.label: Player Food Drain Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for player characters' water consumption. Higher values increase water consumption (player characters get thirsty faster)
settings.label: Player Water Drain Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for player characters' health recovery. Higher values increase the recovery rate (player characters heal faster)
settings.label: Player Health Recovery Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for player characters' stamina consumption. Higher values increase stamina consumption (player characters get tired faster)
settings.label: Player Stamina Drain Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the damage that players cause with their attacks. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values increase damage, lower values decrease it
settings.label: Player Damage Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for players' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack
settings.label: Player Resistance Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for creatures' food consumption. Higher values increase food consumption (creatures get hungry faster)
settings.label: Creature Food Drain Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for creatures' health recovery. Higher values increase the recovery rate (creatures heal faster)
settings.label: Creature Health Recovery Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for creatures' stamina consumption. Higher values increase stamina consumption (creatures get tired faster)
settings.label: Creature Stamina Drain Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the damage that wild creatures cause with their attacks. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values increase damage, lower values decrease it
settings.label: Creature Damage Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for wild creatures' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack
settings.label: Creature Resistance Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for creature spawns. Higher values increase the number of creatures spawned throughout the server
settings.label: Creature Spawn Multiplier

settings.help: Set the scaling factor for the unclaiming speed of creatures in PvE mode
settings.label: PvE Creature Decay Period Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the damage that structures (spikewalls) cause with their attacks. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values increase damage, lower values decrease it
settings.label: Structure Damage Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for structures' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack
settings.label: Structure Resistance Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the decay rate of player structures in PvE mode
settings.label: PvE Structure Decay Period Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the maximum number of structures placeable on platform saddles and rafts. NOTE: high values may lead to lag
settings.label: Maximum Platform Structures Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor, relative to the period for allowing claims, to automatically destroy structures if there has been no near tribe player during that time
settings.label: Auto Structure Destruction Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for yields from all harvesting activities (chopping down trees, picking berries, carving carcasses, mining rocks, etc). Higher values increase the amount harvested with each strike
settings.label: Harvest Amount Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the "health" of harvestable items (trees, rocks, carcasses, etc). Higher values increase the number of strikes needed to destroy them, increasing harvest yields
settings.label: Harvest Health Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for the resource node respawn rate (trees, rocks, bushes, etc). Lower values cause nodes to respawn more frequently
settings.label: Resources Respawn Period Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for creature taming speed. Higher values make taming faster
settings.label: Creature Taming Speed Multiplier

settings.help: Sets the scaling factor for swim speed, relative to the level spent in oxygen
settings.label: Oxygen Swim Speed Multiplier

settings.help: If set, enables the structure stasis grid to improve server performance on large bases with lots of players. Structures are loaded based on grids with players. Not recommended for modded servers
settings.label: Enable Structure Stasis Grid

settings.help: If set, auto destruction of old structures will be enabled. The destruction timer can be adjusted with Auto Structure Destruction Multiplier
settings.label: Auto Destroy Structures

settings.help: If set, any non-core/non-foundation structures will not be auto destroyed (assuming Auto Destroy Structures is enabled), except if a floor they are on is auto destroyed
settings.label: Auto Destroy Core Structures Only

settings.help: If set, only unsnapped core structures will decay (be auto destroyed). Useful for eliminating lone pillar/foundation spam on servers in PvP mode
settings.label: Only Auto Destroy Unsnapped Core Structures

settings.help: If set, the gradual (7 days) decay of player structures will be disabled in PvE mode
settings.label: Disable PvE Structure Decay

settings.help: If set, the gradual decay of structures will be enabled in PvP mode
settings.label: Enable PvP Structure Decay

settings.help: If set, unsnapped foundations/pillars will decay at 5x speed
settings.label: Fast Decay Unsnapped Core Structures

settings.help: Sets the cooldown period on structure repair from the last time damaged. 0 =  disabled (structures can always be repaired)
settings.label: Structure Damage Repair Cooldown

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of platformed-creatures/rafts allowed on the server
settings.label: Maximum Platform Saddle Limit

settings.help: Sets the number of "tamed creature slots" a platform saddle will use
settings.label: Platform Saddle Cost

settings.help: If set, turret and spike structures will be buildable and functional on platform saddles
settings.label: Override Structure Platform Prevention

settings.help: If set, completely disables building in specific resource-rich areas, in particular setup on The Island around the major mountains
settings.label: Disable Building In Rich Resource Areas

settings.help: If set, from-the-air supply crates can appear on top of structures, rather than being prevented by structures
settings.label: Allow Crate Spawns On Structures

settings.help: If set, building near supply drop points will be allowed in PvE mode
settings.label: Allow PvE Structures At Supply Drops

settings.help: If set, allows for structures to clip into the terrain
settings.label: Disable Structure Placement Collision

settings.help: If set, the use of a server cluster will be enabled. Requires Cluster Directory Override and Cluster ID to be set
settings.label: Enable Cluster

settings.help: Sets the path to a shared cluster directory for a server cluster. The cluster directory must be accessible to all cluster servers. If the server is in Docker, the directory must be mounted in the container. Requires Enable Cluster to be set
settings.label: Cluster Directory Override

settings.help: Sets the cluster ID for a server cluster. The cluster ID must be the same on all servers in the cluster. Requires Enable Cluster to be set
settings.label: Cluster ID

settings.help: If set, prevents the download of characters from a cluster to the server
settings.label: Prevent Character Download

settings.help: If set, prevents the download of survivors from a cluster to the server
settings.label: Prevent Survivor Download

settings.help: If set, prevents the download of items from a cluster to the server
settings.label: Prevent Item Download

settings.help: If set, prevents the download of tamed creatures from a cluster to the server
settings.label: Prevent Creature Download

settings.help: If set, prevents the upload of survivors from the server to a cluster
settings.label: Prevent Survivor Upload

settings.help: If set, prevents the upload of items from the server to a cluster
settings.label: Prevent Item Upload

settings.help: If set, prevents the upload of tamed creatures from the server to a cluster
settings.label: Prevent Creature Upload

settings.help: Sets the server branch to install. Update the server after switching branches
settings.label: Server Branch

settings.help: Sets the server name visible in the game browser
settings.label: Server Name

settings.help: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password
settings.label: Server Password

settings.help: Sets the password required for admin access to the server. Default is no password
settings.label: Admin Password

settings.help: Sets the password required by alternate syntax of "serverCommand" server-side scripting. Default is no password
settings.label: Command Password

settings.help: Sets the list of Steam64 IDs for server admins. Format is "SteamID","SteamID"
settings.label: Server Admins

settings.help: Sets the player welcome message (MOTD). Format is "Line1","Line 2"
settings.label: MOTD

settings.help: Sets the time interval between display of each line of the MOTD
settings.label: MOTD Interval

settings.help: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of mod directories to load (not server-side only mods). ONE LINE ONLY! Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths. Alternatively use the Startup Parameters File option
settings.label: Load Mods

settings.help: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of server-side only mod directories to load (the mods are not broadcast to clients). ONE LINE ONLY! Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths. Alternatively use the Startup Parameters File option
settings.label: Load Server Mods

settings.help: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of client-side only mod directories. ONE LINE ONLY! These won't be loaded by the server, but will be used by the Manage Bikeys setting if enabled. Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths
settings.label: Client Mods

settings.help: If enabled, the bikey files for each of the mods specified in Load Mods and Client Mods will be copied to the 'keys' directory on server start, to enable addon signature verification. All existing bikeys in that directory (other than the default 'a3.bikey') will be deleted
settings.label: Manage Bikeys

settings.help: If enabled, players with an ID that is identical to another player will be kicked
settings.label: Disallow Duplicate Game IDs

settings.help: If enabled, players with unknown or unsigned mods will not be allowed to join
settings.label: Addon Signature Verification

settings.help: Specifies whether to prevent or allow file patching for clients
settings.label: Allow Client File Patching

settings.help: Sets a whitelist of Steam64 IDs for clients allowed to use file patching. Format is "SteamID","SteamID"
settings.label: Client File Patching Exceptions

settings.help: Sets the minimum client version, below which clients won't be allowed to join. Default of 99999999 equates to the server version. NOTE: If the server uses the Performance Profiling Build in any way, set this to 0, otherwise no client can connect
settings.label: Minimum Client Version

settings.help: If enabled, the server will be forced into LAN mode - only local clients can connect
settings.label: Force LAN Mode

settings.help: Sets the number of headless clients to launch when the server starts. Further information on configuration is here
settings.label: Headless Clients To Launch

settings.help: Sets the maximum time allowed for the server to successfully start, for any headless clients to be launched. If the server takes longer to start, the clients will not be launched
settings.label: Headless Clients Launch Time Limit

settings.help: Sets the IPs of headless clients able to connect to the server. Multiples connections and IPs are allowed. Format is "IP1","IP2"
settings.label: Headless Client IPs

settings.help: If enabled, allows the use of a parameters file for additional startup parameters for headless clients. File is "hc_parameters.txt" in the server base directory. Useful if the server also uses its own Startup Parameters File for mods. Use with care
settings.label: Use Headless Client Startup Parameters File

settings.help: Sets the IPs of those headless clients listed under Headless Client IPs that have unlimited bandwidth and nearly no latency. Format is "IP1","IP2"
settings.label: Local Headless Client IPs

settings.help: Sets the limit for the server FPS. Setting this too high can have an effect on server performance
settings.label: FPS Limit

settings.help: If enabled, the server will automatically create port mappings on UPnP/IGD enabled routers
settings.label: Enable UPnP

settings.help: Specifies additional startup parameters that are not otherwise set by AMP. Alternatively, use the Startup Parameters File option. Use with care
settings.label: Additional Server Startup Parameters

settings.help: If enabled, allows the use of a parameters file for additional startup parameters for the server. File is "parameters.txt" in the server base directory. Useful for long startup parameters such as -mod or -serverMod. Use with care
settings.label: Use Server Startup Parameters File

settings.help: If enabled, joining players will skip role selection
settings.label: Skip Lobby

settings.help: Sets the minimum number of players required before displaying the mission selection screen
settings.label: Minimum Players For Mission Selection

settings.help: Sets the fraction (0.00 to 1.00) of players needed to vote something into effect
settings.label: Minimum Voting Threshold

settings.help: Sets the Advanced Flight Model mode
settings.label: Advanced Flight Model

settings.help: If set, players will not be able to use in-game voice chat
settings.label: Disable Voice Chat

settings.help: Sets the voice chat codec type
settings.label: Voice Chat Codec

settings.help: Sets the voice sound range: 1-10 is 8kHz (narrowband), 11-20 is 16kHz (wideband), 21-30 is 32kHz (SPEEX) or 48kHz (OPUS) (ultrawideband)
settings.label: Voice Chat Quality

settings.help: If enabled, begins the mission immediately instead of waiting for players to join (autoInit). Requires Persistent Mission to be enabled
settings.label: Start Mission Immediately

settings.help: If enabled, the mission keeps running when all players disconnect. Required for "autoInit" (Start Mission Immediately option)
settings.label: Persistent Mission

settings.help: If enabled, the server auto-starts the next mission in the mission cycle and waits for players in the role selection. Requires a mission cycle to be specified in AMP_server.cfg
settings.label: Enable Automatic Mission Selection

settings.help: If enabled, the server randomly chooses a mission from the mission cycle for starting or auto-starting. Requires a mission cycle to be specified in AMP_server.cfg
settings.label: Enable Random Mission Order

settings.help: If enabled, gives the ability to place markers and draw lines in map
settings.label: Enable Map Lines/Markers

settings.help: If disabled, glasses set in a player's profile will be ignored
settings.label: Allow Profile Glasses

settings.help: Forces the selected difficulty on the server. To use custom difficulty settings, you must configure them in the profile within the A3Master directory
settings.label: Enforce Difficulty

settings.help: If enabled, the server will opt into Arma 3 game analytics
settings.label: Enable Statistics

settings.help: Only allows files with the listed extensions to be loaded via the loadFile command
settings.label: Allowed File Extensions

settings.help: Only allows files with the listed extensions to be loaded via the preprocessFile / preprocessFileLineNumbers commands
settings.label: Allowed Preprocess File Extensions

settings.help: Only allows files and URLs with the listed extensions to be loaded via the htmlLoad command
settings.label: Allowed HTML Extensions

settings.help: Sets the format of the time stamps used in the log file
settings.label: Log Time Stamp Format

settings.help: If enabled, the server logs players' bandwidth and desync info every 60 seconds, as well as "network message is pending" owner identity
settings.label: Log Player Info

settings.help: Sets server side scripting to run when a user has connected
settings.label: Run Script On User Connected

settings.help: Sets server side scripting to run when a user has disconnected
settings.label: Run Script On User Disconnected

settings.help: Sets server side scripting to run when a second user with the same ID is detected
settings.label: Run Script On Double ID Detected

settings.help: Sets server side scripting to run when a user is kicked
settings.label: Run Script On User Kicked

settings.help: Sets server side scripting to run when unsigned data is detected
settings.label: Run Script On Unsigned Data

settings.help: Sets server side scripting to run when a modification of a signed pbo is detected
settings.label: Run Script On Hacked Data

settings.help: Sets server side scripting to run when a signed pbo is detected with a valid signature, but is a different version than a server has. Use with caution
settings.label: Run Script On Different Data

settings.help: Sets the composition script permission level
settings.label: Composition Script Level

settings.help: Sets the maximum Steam query packet size. Increasing this value can be dangerous
settings.label: Steam Query Packet Size

settings.help: If a server-initiated callExtension takes longer than the specified limit, a warning will be logged as well as reflected in the extension return result
settings.label: Call Extension Report Limit

settings.help: If enabled, "object not found" messages will be logged
settings.label: Log Object Not Found

settings.help: If enabled, parsing of description.ext/mission.sqm will be skipped. Will show pbo filename instead of configured missionName
settings.label: Skip Description Parsing

settings.help: If enabled, a mission will load regardless of the number of loading errors
settings.label: Ignore Mission Load Errors

settings.help: If enabled, all of a player's message types and sizes are dumped to a logfile if #monitor is running and the player's Guaranteed Message Queue size goes above the set threshold
settings.label: Message Queue Size Threshold

settings.help: Sets the server wait time before disconnecting a player after loss of an active traffic connection (if Kick On Disconnect Timeout is enabled)
settings.label: Disconnect Timeout

settings.help: If enabled, players hitting the disconnect timeout will be kicked, otherwise that will just be logged
settings.label: Kick On Disconnect Timeout

settings.help: Sets the maximum desync value before the server kicks a player (if Kick On Maximum Desync is enabled)
settings.label: Maximum Desync

settings.help: If enabled, players hitting the maximum desync value will be kicked, otherwise that will just be logged
settings.label: Kick On Maximum Desync

settings.help: Sets the maximum latency (ping) before the server kicks a player (if Kick On Maximum Ping is enabled)
settings.label: Maximum Ping

settings.help: If enabled, players hitting the maximum latency (ping) value will be kicked, otherwise that will just be logged
settings.label: Kick On Maximum Ping

settings.help: Sets the maximum packet loss before the server kicks a player (if Kick On Maximum Packet Loss is enabled)
settings.label: Maximum Packet Loss

settings.help: If enabled, players hitting the maximum packet loss value will be kicked, otherwise that will just be logged
settings.label: Kick On Maximum Packet Loss

settings.help: Sets the time interval before a player can return after a manual kick (such as vote kick, admin kick, bruteforce detection). -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart
settings.label: Manual Kick Waittime

settings.help: Sets the time interval before a player can return after a connectivity kick (ping, timeout, packetloss, desync). -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart
settings.label: Connectivity Kick Waittime

settings.help: Sets the time interval before a player can return after a BattlEye kick. -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart
settings.label: BattlEye Kick Waittime

settings.help: Sets the time interval before a player can return after a harmless kick (such as wrong addons, Steam timeout or checks, signatures, content, etc). -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart
settings.label: Harmless Kick Waittime

settings.help: Sets the time limit for voting. Format is <ready number>,<not ready number>
settings.label: Voting Timeout

settings.help: Sets the time limit for role selection. Format is <ready number>,<not ready number>
settings.label: Role Selection Timeout

settings.help: Sets the time limit for briefing. Format is <ready number>,<not ready number>
settings.label: Briefing Timeout

settings.help: Sets the time limit for debriefing. Format is <ready number>,<not ready number>
settings.label: Debriefing Timeout

settings.help: Sets the time limit for lobby idle
settings.label: Lobby Idle Timeout

settings.help: Sets how long a player will wait for armaUnits data when connecting
settings.label: ArmaUnits Data Timeout

settings.help: Sets whether to run the 64 bit or 32 bit version of the server executable
settings.label: Server Executable

settings.help: Sets the server branch (or branches) to install. Some require a Beta Password. NOTE: Update the server after switching branches, and set the Minimum Client Version to 0 if using the Performance Profiling Build in any way!
settings.label: Server Branch

settings.help: If set, mods downloaded under "Steam workshop items" will be linked to the server base directory in the format @modname, rather than just by reference to the mod ID. NOTE: Update the server after changing this setting
settings.label: Enable Named Mod Directory Links

settings.help: Server name shown in the server list
settings.label: Server Name

settings.help: Server description shown in the server list. Requires the galaxy to be generated first
settings.label: Server Description

settings.help: Sets the password to connect to the server. Default is no password. Requires the galaxy to be generated first
settings.label: Server Password

settings.help: If enabled, the server will be displayed on public server lists. Requires the "Steam Relay Network" connection mode
settings.label: List Server

settings.help: Sets the connection mode - either through the Steam relay network, or via a direct port connection on the Game Port. Steam relay network is recommended for dedicated servers
settings.label: Connection Mode

settings.help: Sets the galaxy name for the server, with the world data saved under this name in the "galaxies" directory. Start and stop the server after changing this setting to allow galaxy generation
settings.label: Galaxy Name

settings.help: Sets the seed to generate the galaxy. Alphanumeric characters only. Default is 0. Changing this after the server has been running and players logged in can lead to broken saves
settings.label: Galaxy Seed

settings.help: Sets the scenario for the galaxy. Changing this after the server has been running and players logged in can lead to broken saves
settings.label: Galaxy Scenario

settings.help: Sets the difficulty level of the server
settings.label: Server Difficulty

settings.help: Comma-separated list of Steam64 IDs of the server administrators
settings.label: Server Administrators

settings.help: Sets the time interval between auto saves
settings.label: Save Interval

settings.help: If enabled, all players will start in the same sector
settings.label: Same Sector Start

settings.help: Sets the level of damage to an object on collison. 0 = no damage, 1 = full damage
settings.label: Collision Damage Level

settings.help: Sets the server branch to install. NOTE: Update the server after switching branches!
settings.label: Server Branch

settings.help: Sets the name of the server that appears in the server list
settings.label: Server Name

settings.help: Comma-separated list of server tags that give additional information about the server in the server browser
settings.label: Server Tags

settings.help: Sets the ID of the steam group that the server belongs to. You can find your group's ID on the admin profile page in the steam community
settings.label: Server Steam Group

settings.help: If enabled, the server will operate as a LAN server: no heartbeat, no authentication, and no non-class C addresses
settings.label: LAN Server

settings.help: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password
settings.label: Server Password

settings.help: Sets the map to start the server with. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Initial Map must also be specified
settings.label: Initial Map

settings.help: Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected
settings.label: Custom Initial Map

settings.help: Sets the server region shown in the server list
settings.label: Server Region

settings.help: Sets the maximum players reported to prospective clients, regardless of the Player Limit. -1 = disabled
settings.label: Visible Player Limit
