settings.help: Enables API access (Undocumented feature)
settings.label: Enable API

settings.help: Sets the server release stream to install. Note: Update the server after changing this setting
settings.label: Server Release Stream

settings.help: If set, BepInEx will be installed when the server is updated and enabled when the server is run, allowing the server to be modded. Configure "BepInEx Version" accordingly. Mods must be installed in the BepInEx/plugins directory, which is created after BepInEx is first run. Requires Wine 8 staging build on Linux (and Xvfb and cabextract)
settings.label: Activate BepInEx

settings.help: Sets the BepInEx version to install. Empty = latest. NOTE: Update the server after switching versions!
settings.label: BepInEx Version

settings.help: Sets the Proton GE release version to install. Empty = latest. Example: GE-Proton9-1
settings.label: Proton GE Release Version (Linux)

settings.help: Sets the server name as shown in the in-game browser and, if applicable, the Steam browser
settings.label: Server Public Name

settings.help: If enabled, the server will be visible in the in-game browser (Steam-enabled servers are always visible in the Steam server browser)
settings.label: Make Server Public

settings.help: Sets the description displayed in the in-game browser. Use "\n" to create a new line in the description
settings.label: Server Public Description

settings.help: Sets the password for players to connect to the server. Default is no password
settings.label: Server Password

settings.help: Sets the in-game "admin" user password (not the server password). Set before first running the server, or you will be prompted to do so in the console
settings.label: Admin Password

settings.help: If enabled, admins will be hidden in the player list. Requires b42
settings.label: Hide Admins In Player List

settings.help: Sets the password to connect to RCON. Default is a random, strong password
settings.label: RCON Password

settings.help: Sets the first welcome message visible in the chat panel, which is displayed immediately after player login. Use <LINE> to create a separate line, and colour formatting like <RGB:1,0,0> to colour the text
settings.label: Welcome Message

settings.help: If enabled, players may join the server without already being included in the whitelist. Otherwise, admins must manually create username/password combinations
settings.label: Enable Open Server

settings.help: Automatically add unknown usernames to the whitelist when players join (for open servers). Players will supply their own username/password on joining
settings.label: Automatically Whitelist Players

settings.help: If set, player accounts will be removed from the whitelist after death. This prevents players creating a new character after death on non-open servers
settings.label: Drop Off Whitelist After Death

settings.help: If set, clients whose game files don't match the server's file will be kicked
settings.label: Enable Lua Checksum Kick

settings.help: If set, login will be denied on an overloaded server
settings.label: Deny Login On Overloaded Server

settings.help: If set, the login queue will be enabled
settings.label: Enable Login Queue

settings.help: Sets the connection timeout for the login queue
settings.label: Login Queue Connect Timeout

settings.help: Sets Java's maximum heap size
settings.label: Memory Limit

settings.help: The default Java garbage collection algorithm is ZGC, but G1GC can be selected for older Windows versions that cannot use ZGC
settings.label: Java Garbage Collection Algorithm (Windows)

settings.help: If set, enables the Steam VAC system
settings.label: Enable Valve Anti-cheat (Steam VAC)

settings.help: Enable Steam integration
settings.label: Steam Integration

settings.help: Semi-colon separated list of maps to load on the server. ONE LINE ONLY!
settings.label: Maps

settings.help: Semi-colon separated list of mod IDs (eg 67commando;86oshkoshP19A) to load. With b42, prefix each ID with \. ONE LINE ONLY! To install them, the workshop IDs for the mods also need to be added to Install Workshop Items
settings.label: Load Mods

settings.help: Semi-colon separated list of IDs of workshop items (eg 2478247379;2566953935) to install. ONE LINE ONLY! To load them, the mod IDs also need to be added to Load Mods. NOTE: Don't use "Steam workshop items" under Updates
settings.label: Install Workshop Items

settings.help: If enabled, displays players' usernames above their heads in-game
settings.label: Display Player Usernames

settings.help: If enabled, displays players' first and last names above their heads in-game instead of usernames
settings.label: Display Player Character Names

settings.help: If enabled, players will have to mouse over someone to see their display name
settings.label: Require Mouse Over To See Display Name

settings.help: If enabled, allows the use of non-ASCII (cyrillic etc) characters in usernames
settings.label: Allow Non-ASCII Usernames

settings.help: If enabled, players can disguise their username in-game. Requires b42
settings.label: Enable Username Disguises

settings.help: If enabled, disguised usernames are hidden from certain UI elements. Requires b42
settings.label: Hide Disguised Username

settings.help: If enabled, zombies may switch ownership between players on each update. Requires b42
settings.label: Switch Zombies Ownership Each Update

settings.help: Sets the limit on the number of different accounts a single Steam user may create on the server
settings.label: Maximum Accounts Per User

settings.help: If set, allows co-op/splitscreen players
settings.label: Allow Co-op/Splitscreen Players

settings.help: Sets whether steam usernames and avatars are visible in the player list
settings.label: Steam Scoreboard

settings.help: If enabled, the scoreboard will be disabled. Requires b42
settings.label: Disable Scoreboard

settings.help: If enabled, game time stops when there are no players online
settings.label: Pause When Empty

settings.help: Sets the ping limit before a player is kicked from the server. To disable, set to 100 (b41) or 0 (b42)
settings.label: Ping Limit

settings.help: Sets the real-world time between each automatic save of loaded parts of the map. 0 = never. (The map is usually saved only after clients leave a loaded area)
settings.label: Auto World Save Interval

settings.help: Sets the number of backups to keep
settings.label: Backups Count

settings.help: If enable, backups will be taken on server start
settings.label: Enable Backups On Start

settings.help: If set, backups will be taken on version change
settings.label: Enable Backups On Version Change

settings.help: Sets the period between backups. 0 = disabled
settings.label: Backups Period

settings.help: Sets the IP from which the server is broadcast. Useful for network configurations with multiple IP addresses such as server farms
settings.label: Server Browser Announced IP

settings.help: Semicolon-separated list of commands that will not be written to the cmd.txt server log. Example: -vehicle. Inputting * means do NOT write any vehicle command. Inputting +vehicle.installPart means DO write that command
settings.label: Client Command Filter

settings.help: Semicolon-separated list of actions that will be written to the ClientActionLogs.txt server log
settings.label: Client Action Logs

settings.help: If enabled, changes in player perk levels will be tracked in the PerkLog.txt server log
settings.label: Enable Perk Logs

settings.help: If enabled, the server will attempt to configure automatic port forwarding on a compatible router
settings.label: Enable UPnP

settings.help: Sets the multiplayer update period. 0 = disabled. Requires b42
settings.label: Multiplayer Statistics Period

settings.help: Additional Java arguments (not server arguments) as startup parameters that are not otherwise set by AMP. Use with care
settings.label: Additional Java Startup Parameters

settings.help: Server name as stored locally. WARNING: Do not change unless you know what you are doing! Also update the server if this is changed
settings.label: Server Local Name

settings.help: Additional server arguments (not Java arguments) as startup parameters that are not otherwise set by AMP. Use with care
settings.label: Additional Server Startup Parameters

settings.help: Sets the Java class type to launch the server with. If Custom is selected, it must be set under "Custom Java Class". Custom is required for some mods. Use with care
settings.label: Java Class

settings.help: Sets the custom Java class to launch the server with, if Custom is selected under "Java Class"
settings.label: Custom Java Class

settings.help: Sets the spawn point for every new player. Default is 0,0,0. Find desired coordinates
settings.label: Set Spawn Point

settings.help: Comma-separated list of item types that new players spawn with
settings.label: Spawn Items

settings.help: If set, players will be able to respawn in-game at the coordinates where they died
settings.label: Enable Player Respawn At Death Coordinates

settings.help: If set, players will be allowed to respawn in-game at a split screen / Remote Play player's location
settings.label: Enable Player Respawn At Other's Location

settings.help: If enabled, players can hurt and kill other players
settings.label: Allow PvP

settings.help: If enabled, PvP events will be posted to the admin chat. Requires b42
settings.label: Log PvP To Admin Chat

settings.help: If enabled, PvP events will be written to the server log file. Requires b42
settings.label: Log PvP To File

settings.help: If enabled, allows players to enter and leave PvP mode on an individual basis. A player can only hurt another player when at least one of them is in PvP mode. Requires "Allow PvP" to be enabled
settings.label: Enable PvP Toggle (Safety System)

settings.help: If enabled, displays a skull icon above the heads of players who have entered PvP mode
settings.label: Show Player PvP Status

settings.help: Sets the time taken for a player to enter and leave PvP mode
settings.label: PvP Toggle Timer

settings.help: Sets the delay before a player can enter or leave PvP mode again, having recently done so
settings.label: PvP Cooldown Timer

settings.help: Sets the delay before a disconnected player's PvP safety is removed. Requires b42
settings.label: PvP Disconnect Delay

settings.help: If enabled, players can hit again when struck by another player
settings.label: Enable PvP Melee While Hit Reaction

settings.help: Sets the damage multiplier for PvP melee attacks
settings.label: PvP Melee Damage Modifier

settings.help: Sets the damage multiplier for PvP ranged attacks
settings.label: PvP Firearm Damage Modifier

settings.help: If enabled, factions can be created and used
settings.label: Enable Factions

settings.help: Number of in-game days that a player must survive for before they can create a faction
settings.label: Game Days For Factions

settings.help: Sets the number of players required as faction members before the faction owner can create a group tag
settings.label: Faction Players Required For Tag

settings.help: Sets how long nighttime lasts depending on daytime: 0.5 means twice as long, 2 means half the normal time. Requires b41 - b42 use "Nighttime Length (Sandbox)" instead. Note that on b41 the sandbox "Nighttime Length" setting also applies
settings.label: Nighttime Length

settings.help: Sets the time from dusk to dawn. This is a sandbox setting and applies on both b41 and b42. On b42 it replaces the .ini-based "Nighttime Length" multiplier, which b42 no longer reads. The "Always Day" option requires b42
settings.label: Nighttime Length (Sandbox)

settings.help: If enabled, fires are not allowed (except campfires). Enable if fires cause problems for your server
settings.label: Don't Allow Fire

settings.help: If enabled, a global message is displayed in the chat when a player dies
settings.label: Announce Player Death

settings.help: Sets the number of in-game minutes it takes to read one page of a book. Requires b41
settings.label: Minutes Per Book Page

settings.help: Sets the in-game hours after which all containers that have been looted at least once will respawn loot. 0 = never. Loot respawn is not impacted by visibility or subsequent looting. Requires b41
settings.label: Minimum Period for Loot Respawn

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of items that containers can hold to be allowed to respawn. If the number of items is less than or equal to the number set, loot will respawn. Requires b41
settings.label: Maximum Items for Loot Respawn

settings.help: Sets the maximum number of items that can be placed in a container. Includes individual small items like nails. 0 = no limit
settings.label: Item Limit Per Container

settings.help: If enabled, items will not respawn in buildings that players have barricaded or built in. Requires b41
settings.label: Construction Prevents Respawn

settings.help: If enabled, items will not respawn in buildings that players have claimed as a safehouse. Requires b42
settings.label: Safehouse Prevents Respawn

settings.help: If enabled, both admins and players can claim safehouses
settings.label: Allow Player Safehouses

settings.help: If enabled, only admins can claim safehouses
settings.label: Allow Admin Safehouses

settings.help: If set, disables a safehouse when a member of the safehouse is connected, so that it acts like a normal house and is only secure when players are offline. Renamed in b42 - use "Disable Safehouse When Owner Connected" instead
settings.label: Disable Safehouse When Player Connected

settings.help: If set, a safehouse acts like a normal house while its owner is connected, so it is only secure when the owner is offline. Requires b42.18 or later, where it replaced DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected
settings.label: Disable Safehouse When Owner Connected

settings.help: If enabled, non-members can enter a safehouse without being invited
settings.label: Allow Safehouse Trespass

settings.help: If enabled, safehouses can be damaged by fire
settings.label: Allow Safehouse Fire

settings.help: If enabled, non-members can loot safehouses
settings.label: Allow Safehouse Loot

settings.help: If enabled, players will respawn in a safehouse they were a member of before death
settings.label: Allow Safehouse Respawn

settings.help: Sets the number of in-game days that a player must survive for before they can claim a safehouse
settings.label: Game Days For Safehouse

settings.help: Players are automatically removed from a safehouse they have not visited for this many real-time hours
settings.label: Safehouse Removal Period

settings.help: If enabled, players can claim non-residential buildings
settings.label: Allow Non-Residential Safehouses

settings.help: If enabled, disguises will be disabled while inside a safehouse. Requires b42
settings.label: Disable Disguises In Safehouse

settings.help: Sets the maximum allowed safezone size. Requires b42
settings.label: Maximum Safezone Size

settings.help: If enabled, players can destroy world objects with sledgehammers
settings.label: Allow Sledgehammer Destruction

settings.help: If enabled, players can destroy world objects with sledgehammers only in their safehouse. Requires "Allow Sledgehammer Destruction" to be enabled
settings.label: Allow Only Safehouse Sledgehammers

settings.help: Sets the time before the war starts. Requires b42
settings.label: War Start Delay

settings.help: Sets the war duration. Requires b42
settings.label: War Duration

settings.help: Sets the safehouse hit points limit. Requires b42
settings.label: War Safehouse Hit Points

settings.help: If enabled, players that appear to be moving faster than is possible will be kicked. May be buggy - use with caution. Requires b41
settings.label: Kick Fast Players

settings.help: Sets the speed limit for players
settings.label: Speed Limit

settings.help: If enabled, players are allowed to sleep when tired, but do not need to
settings.label: Allow Sleep

settings.help: If enabled, players become tired and need to sleep. Requires "Allow Sleep" to be enabled
settings.label: Require Sleep

settings.help: Sets how fast time passes while players sleep
settings.label: Sleep Fast Forward Multiplier

settings.help: If set, players can be knocked down. Activating this setting may cause visual desynchronization of player positions
settings.label: Allow Knock Down

settings.help: If enabled, players will bump (and knock over) other players when running through them
settings.label: Enable Player Bump Player

settings.help: If enabled, players that can't be seen will be automatically hidden (like zombies)
settings.label: Hide Players Behind You

settings.help: If set, players in sneak mode will be hidden from other players
settings.label: Hide From Other Players In Sneak Mode

settings.help: If enabled, the Ultra Speed effect will not apply to animals. Requires b42
settings.label: Ultra Speed Does Not Affect Animals

settings.help: If enabled, when 'HoursForCorpseRemoval' triggers, it will also remove player’s corpses from the ground
settings.label: Remove Player Corpses On Corpse Removal

settings.help: Sets the number of days before old blood splats are removed. Removal happens when map chunks are loaded. 0 = splats never disappear
settings.label: Blood Splats Lifespan Days

settings.help: If set, enables the global sound for ban and kick messages
settings.label: Enable Ban/Kick Global Sound

settings.help: If enabled, players can use the 'delete all' button on bins
settings.label: Enable Trash Delete All

settings.help: Modifies the range of zombie attraction to cars. Lower values can help lag
settings.label: Car Engine Attraction Modifier

settings.help: Controls the display of remote players on the in-game map
settings.label: Remote Player Map Visibility

settings.help: If set, vehicle towing will be disabled. Requires b42
settings.label: Disable Vehicle Towing

settings.help: If set, trailer towing will be disabled. Requires b42
settings.label: Disable Trailer Towing

settings.help: If enabled, burnt vehicles cannot be towed. Requires b42
settings.label: Disable Burnt Vehicle Towing

settings.help: If enabled, physics-based hit reactions are used. Requires b42
settings.label: Use Physics Hit Reactions

settings.help: If enabled, players can communicate with everyone (using the /all command in chat)
settings.label: Enable Global Chat

settings.help: Sets the enabled chat streams for different message targets. Options: s (say), r (radio), a (all), w (whisper), y (yell), sh (safehouse), f (faction), all
settings.label: Chat Streams

settings.help: Sets the maximum characters allowed per chat message. Requires b42
settings.label: Chat Message Character Limit

settings.help: Sets the time between sending chat messages when slow mode is enabled. Requires b42
settings.label: Chat Message Slow Mode Time

settings.help: If set, VOIP will be enabled
settings.label: Enable VOIP

settings.help: Sets the minimum tile distance over which VOIP sounds can be heard
settings.label: Minimum Distance For VOIP

settings.help: Sets the maximum tile distance over which VOIP sounds can be heard
settings.label: Maximum Distance For VOIP

settings.help: If set, enables directional audio for VOIP
settings.label: Enable VOIP 3D

settings.help: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with a 'staff' access level
settings.label: Disable Radio For Staff

settings.help: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with an 'admin' access level
settings.label: Disable Radio For Admins

settings.help: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with a 'gm' access level
settings.label: Disable Radio For GMs

settings.help: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with an 'overseer' access level
settings.label: Disable Radio For Overseers

settings.help: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with a 'moderator' access level
settings.label: Disable Radio For Moderators

settings.help: Disable radio transmissions from invisible players
settings.label: Disable Radio For Invisible Players

settings.help: Sets the path to a file with the list of words to be prohibited. One word per line. Requires b42
settings.label: Bad Word List File

settings.help: Sets the path to a file with words that are allowed even if they contain bad words. One word per line. Requires b42
settings.label: Good Word List File

settings.help: Sets the action to take when a bad word is detected. Requires b42
settings.label: Bad Word Policy

settings.help: Sets the symbol or text that replaces a detected bad word. Requires b42
settings.label: Bad Word Replacement

settings.help: If enabled, allows global text chat integration with a Discord channel. Requires a valid bot token to be set under "Discord Token"
settings.label: Enable Discord Integration

settings.help: Sets the bot token to access the Discord servers
settings.label: Discord Token

settings.help: Sets the name of the Discord channel to integrate with. Use "Discord Channel ID" if this does not work. Requires b41 - on b42 use "Discord Chat Channel" instead
settings.label: Discord Channel

settings.help: Sets the name of the Discord chat channel to integrate with. Requires b42, where it replaced DiscordChannel
settings.label: Discord Chat Channel

settings.help: Sets the ID of the Discord channel to integrate with. Use this if "Discord Channel" does not work
settings.label: Discord Channel ID

settings.help: Sets the Slack incoming webhook URL for posting messages to a Slack channel. Requires b42
settings.label: Slack Incoming Webhook URL
